sections.name: POST
sections.title: PDF text reader
sections.what: Checks the upload is a real PDF, reads its text, and returns it, with clear messages for scanned or broken files.
sections.why: The messages guide the user to a working alternative.
sections.watch_out: The package is loaded with require inside the function, so the package and its build setting must stay in place or the build may break.

summary: Pulls the text out of an uploaded PDF and rejects files that are not PDFs or have no readable text.
purpose: Lets users upload PDF job descriptions or documents instead of pasting text.
why: Likely reason: many job descriptions and resumes are shared as PDFs.
how: Decodes the base64 data into bytes, checks the file starts with the PDF header, reads the text with pdf-parse, and returns it. Scanned PDFs with no text get a message suggesting a screenshot instead.
outputs: Extracted text, or an error with status 400, 422, or 500.
risks: The whole file is loaded into memory, so very large PDFs use a lot of memory. Scanned PDFs produce no text.
debug: A 422 about scanned images means the PDF has no text layer. If extraction fails with a package error, confirm pdf-parse is installed and that next.config.js lists it under serverExternalPackages.
